values.en: For an arc-length parametrized space curve $\gamma$, the norm of the vector curvature is the (non-negative) curvature: $\lVert\boldsymbol{\kappa}_{\gamma}(s)\rVert=\kappa_{\gamma}(s)=\lVert\gamma''(s)\rVert$. Thus the curvature is the length of the curvature vector, and it vanishes exactly where the curvature vector does.
values.zh-CN: 对以弧长为参数的空间曲线 $\gamma$，向量曲率的范数就是（非负的）曲率：$\lVert\boldsymbol{\kappa}_{\gamma}(s)\rVert=\kappa_{\gamma}(s)=\lVert\gamma''(s)\rVert$。因此曲率是向量曲率的长度，且恰在向量曲率为零处为零。
